description: Income/expense/transfer. from+income = received. IOU repayment/lend need category + person_id (direction from/to). Invoice: iou_type invoice. Open-IOU income needs not_iou_repayment=true. Unknown person_id errors; changes nothing. ($0.10; API key required)

account_id.description: Stable provider account identity for imported payments.

cash_moved.description: With category "IOU lend": true (default) = cash changed hands as a loan (Finance); false = an owed share (IOU only). Ignored for iou_type invoice.

category.description: Ledger category (e.g. Salary, Gift, Food & Dining). "IOU repayment" / "IOU lend" / "Invoice payment" need person_id.

client_label.description: Optional free-text client label for an invoice IOU.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; default today. Prefer with time + timezone when the source has a clock time.

iou_type.description: loan (default) or invoice. Invoice = unpaid receivable (no Finance outflow); payment is income "Invoice payment". "I lent…" → loan.

mirror_event.description: Also insert optional Money calendar event (default false)

not_iou_repayment.description: true only when income from a contact with an open IOU is unrelated to it.

notes.description: Free text about the payment. Alias: description.

occurred_at.description: Offset-aware ISO timestamp from the source. Never use ingestion/created_at.

person_id.description: Owned contact id; required for IOU categories. Unknown/other-user id errors and changes nothing.

person_name.description: Contact by name when there is no person_id (IOU categories need one).

project.description: Project label stored as project:{slug} tag, e.g. Max Soko poker venture.

request_id.description: Client idempotency key (retries return original result).

tags.description: Optional tags. Prefer project: / ext: / rail: grammar.

time.description: HH:mm or HH:mm:ss; no default. Pair with timezone or occurred_at.

time_certainty.description: exact, inferred, or unknown. Default exact when time/occurred_at is set.

timezone.description: IANA timezone or ±HH:MM; required for an exact instant with date+time.
